items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: Sure, sure. We both went to Tuxedo van at the same time.

ctx.x: You mean Chiney played with you, George? Sure, sure. We both went to Tuxedo van at the same time. That boy in those late days, huh? I know George talks about it. I didn't know you were still in the van. I forgot about it. I guess George just told me.
Were there any other personnel changes later on, around 1930, earlier? Oh, I don't know. In Celestine. Oh, yeah, the pilot police.
